title: St. James Town Sailing Club

services.name: Learn to Sail
services.desc: St. James Town Sailing Club (aka JTown) is a vibrant, co-operatively run, community club in Toronto’s Port Lands with over 200 members and a long history of excellence in both dinghy racing and sailing instruction. The club owns a (lending library) fleet of 18 Albacores, 7 Lasers, and 3 Catamarans. JTown has no employees, and is looking for independent sailing instructors to join an existing team and work together to support our members’ learning journey. Apart from CanSail and Laser classes, all other work at the clubhouse is performed by volunteers. - Independent accredited sailing instructors bill the club for their time at an agreed upon rate (usually aligned with the Checklick survey

services.name: LASER clinics
services.desc: Each course consists of one mandatory introductory session, plus approximately 14 mandatory class hours. The first date of each laser clinic is a mandatory on-land lesson about boat-setup. All subsequent classes include both an on-water component, and in-class component (wind/weather permitting). services.desc: JTown members may register for intermediate learn to sail courses, taught by qualified Sail Canada Instructors, hosted at JTown. JTown does not offer learn to sail courses to non-members (unless pre-approved by the Commodore on an exceptional basis). You can apply to become a member, here. Members must be aged 19+
